evolution.weakness_hypothesis: The official baseline is about 0.637 while the current public leader is 0.30543, proving large algorithmic headroom remains. The benchmark macro-averages four very different platforms, so MOME can preserve specialists for platform regimes while selecting a single legal shared-weight model that improves the weakest-platform frontier.

canary.promotion_rule: PROMOTE only if the released baseline reproduces and a bounded adaptation improves held-out/public proxy score by >=5% relative without platform-specific separate models; otherwise kill before multi-day training.

probability.basis: The current public #1 is 0.30543 versus 0.31908 for #2 and the official released baseline is about 0.637. The benchmark is highly buyer-legible and the public stack is reproducible, but beating a strong top result from an 87-team field within one week likely requires significant GPU training and careful generalization.

notes: Prestige/contract-conversion challenger. Official final submission, technical report and public model artifacts are due Sep 20, 2026. Lower immediate crown probability than MICRO/TrafficFlow because of the stronger incumbent and training cost.
